pairs.registryProposal: The golden path assumes a separate fake plane. A product that seeds demo rows into its real store through the write path (embedded-DB, self-hosted) gets most of its guidance from mixed-plane-coexistence, while runtime-dispatch and one-interface do not fit. A short paragraph on the 'seeded-store demo' shape, saying which clauses survive (row marker, source-owned predicate, explicit seed act) and which drop, would stop seats from flagging boot-time env seeding as a dispatch deviation.
